ref_text: There's a store with no exits. And at ten p.m.... the lights go out. Then you see the staff. Tall. Silent. No faces.
text: It sits in a steel cube. Curled up. Almost two and a half meters tall. Arms too long.

ref_text: I can hear it moving in the dark. Every time the lights go out... it gets closer. Please. I can't keep my eyes open much longer.
text: Nothing has ever stopped it. Not walls. Not doors. Not distance.
